items.title: Whoop just launched a social network
items.summary: Whoop is launching a social network that lets members share their sleep, recovery and workout data, but the bigger bet is on becoming more of a personal health brand, with CEO Will Ahmed hinting at acquisitions to come.
items.creator: Connie Loizos

items.title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
items.summary: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is taking over as an interim replacement for longtime CEO Jensen Huang, who is embroiled in scandal.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling

items.title: Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund
items.summary: This is the investment firm's largest fund to date.
items.creator: Kirsten Korosec
